findings.scenario: Observe whether Changes in deployed and high-alert warhead estimates, arms-control participation, and public nuclear-use signaling moves in the direction of concern: Rising deployed or high-alert totals, abandoned constraints, or more explicit use threats
findings.observationCadence: quarterly signal scan and annual source refresh
findings.measurableTrigger: A material adverse change in two monitored indicators or a new SIPRI assessment
findings.boundedResponse: Maintain an auditable public-source escalation dashboard and draft geographically diverse continuity options
findings.rollback: Retire the dashboard version, preserve its evidence record, and restore the last verified indicator definitions
findings.authorityBoundary: The automated body may monitor public data and draft bounded options. Any credentialed access, outreach, spending, physical action, or legal commitment requires a separately classified packet; human escalation is allowed only when a documented owner-only capability remains truly unautomatable.
